method: Individual building/range envelopes manually read from period maps. Dimensions and elevations are reconstruction estimates; each record separates mapped floor marks from selected model heights.

goad-f3.registration: Provisional similarity via author screenshot and GIS; extrapolation beyond the initial Quinine controls requires site review.

goad-f17.registration: Similarity fit to six corresponding building centres on georeferenced OS and listed mill locations; hand-picked controls, not survey precision.

os-1893.attribution: Reproduced with the permission of the National Library of Scotland, https://maps.nls.uk/
os-1893.registration: Manually read on the georeferenced tile mosaic in scene metres, EPSG:27700 origin 538900,183209. Rounded envelopes, not survey precision.

goad-f3-city.registration: Local Quinine/GIS registration retained after wider OS comparison: georeferenced OS and supplied river polygons differ locally. Alternative OS fit retained for review; model position uses existing river datum.

goad-f3-sugar.registration: Regional similarity fit to corresponding range centres manually read on georeferenced 1893 OS. Fit residual is internal; map generalisation and hand readings limit absolute accuracy.

ase-2013200.use: Building 16 construction date, five-storey form, paired roof, red brick and elevation proportions; excludes undated 1894–1916 annexes and modern alterations.

bromley-1924.use: Later comparison only. New buildings, 1916 rail connection and later holder tiers are not backdated.
bromley-1924.credit: Historic England / Aerofilms; research reference only, not published as an asset.

goad-f2-sawmill.registration: Local similarity fit to four manually matched range centres on georeferenced OS; source map generalisation and selection uncertainty remain. Do not use this fit for the soap works.

goad-f2-soap.registration: Similarity fit to four corners of the main soap-house block on georeferenced OS. Local fit, approximate corners; comparison at northern ranges required before inferring precise parcel boundaries.

goad-f4-jute.registration: Local similarity fit to four OS mill-envelope controls. Approximate hand-picked corners, not surveyed registration.

crory-jute-1876.use: Earlier eyewitness account: Wm Ritchie & Sons, bale storage, production sequence and steam power. Not evidence of exact 1893 room dimensions or occupancy. Author praises employers; distinguish descriptions from his judgements.

os-bromley-production.registration: Cropped cached georeferenced NLS tiles; local similarity fitted to projected corner coordinates. Structure identification remains interpretive.

scopeNotes: Includes entire Bromley gasworks production ground as well as nine holders.
Includes Channelsea-side manure works as gasworks northern boundary context.
Includes full East London Soap Works and New Imperial Saw Mills beyond the clipped original GIS edge.

September 26 street pass: approximate range envelopes are clipped at registered 1893 OS road/pavement corridors. Selected frontage placements corrected after street overlay; original envelope and previous placement retained. Render geometry is still an interpretation, not a measured building survey.

Author-requested western Old Lea industrial frontage from Three Mills to the Great Eastern Main Line, with adjacent Bow industrial ranges. Individual envelopes read from locally archived NLS five-foot OS mapping. Site IDs and uses cross-checked against the supplied Industry_1893-95 dataset. Heights, roofs, chimneys and stock are interpreted for the flyover, not measured reconstructions.
